notes.title: Small Update and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello! Pushing live a patch with the small updates and bug fixes from developing the Nintendo Switch port of [b]Before the Green Moon[/b].

It should be safe to update with an active save but there is some save-data updating happening so please let me know if you encounter anything strange! (here or at turnfollow@gmail)

[list]
[*]Adjusted the way that dialog is selected so less is skipped. This means that you should reach the end of a character's dialog more slowly and see more of it along the way.
[*]Fixed campfires not triggering while Int is away.
[*]Some art updates and tweaks throughout (check out the elevator at night)
[*]Fixed an infrequent but serious bug where all crops, debris and items on the farm could be deleted.
[*]Added a few points of interest to the archives.
[*]Fixed lighting in character creator.
[*]Fixed an issue with equipment not equipping correctly from storage.
[*]Fixed a few places you could fall out of the map.
[*]Added minor optimizations to increase frame rate, memory usage and load times. (particularly in the "Low" setting)
[*]Other misc. balance tweaks and bug fixes.
[/list]

Thank you for all of your support and for playing our game!

notes.title: Small Update / Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello! Some fixes for some bugs and a couple of balance tweaks.

[list]
[*] Chicken heads now load color correctly.
[*] Fixed bug when 3+ chickens ran away at once.
[*] Chickens spawn slightly more often in the forest.
[*] Increased seed minimums at drop box.
[*] Added additional campfire scenes for when a someone isn't around.
[*] Some nighttime Elvis cutscenes are easier to see.
[*] Cancel button breaking conversation choices fixed.
[*] Increased delay before choice is selectable to prevent skipping passed.
[*] Entering a cutscene while holding a full water transport no longer breaks the game.
[/list]
